physical_or_evidence_reason.summary: the frozen DBF-1 upstream implementation cannot remain: on the admitted Rust chain and the registered conservation bound it delivers 33.6 x less than the necessary 12 mN flow at its worst state, is out of model domain (dead-head) in four of the ten admitted surface scenarios, and its compressor model mass is about twice the AL-02 allocation; its compressor coefficients are uncited code defaults

BD-01.finding: worst-state delivered flow 1.428e-9 kg/s (worst covered scenario maxwell_a0.5) against the A4 necessary flow 4.796e-8 kg/s for 12 mN at the ideal 1.5 kW (k = 33.59); 2.082e-7 kg/s for 25 mN (k = 145.8); A_eff 0.25 m^2 < A_req 0.2511 m^2

BD-02.finding: F7 Pareto member in 6 of 10 admitted scenarios; out of domain in maxwell_a0, maxwell_a0.2, cll_a0, cll_a0.2 (TARGET_AT_OR_ABOVE_DEAD_HEAD_PRESSURE); F8 robust set EMPTY (reasons over the F8 survivors: GAEDE_CHARACTERISTIC_OUTSIDE_K_1_TO_K0, TARGET_AT_OR_ABOVE_DEAD_HEAD_PRESSURE); M2 feed-loop classes R 44 / S 1916

BD-03.finding: compressor model mass 10.907 kg against the AL-02 compressor+drive allocation 5.5 kg (excess 5.41 kg)

compressor_coefficients.finding: every fixed DragCompressor coefficient (turbo kS, kK, blade fraction, disc thicknesses, stator / motor / bearing mass factors, leak conductance, bearing loss, motor efficiency, control power, sink conductance) is an uncited code default (F3 coefficients FIXED_CODE_DEFAULT_UNCITED; compressor_downselect CD-01)

physical_or_evidence_reason.not_a_reason: improving an M2 result is not a reason (DCR_PROCESS.md); the reason is that the registered necessary conditions (A4 / A8 flow, scenario robustness, AL-02 mass) are not met by the frozen implementation
